item.title: Unit 2 Reflection Blog
item.description:
UNIT 2 - REFLECTION

Unit 2 was difficult as well as an interesting unit. The most interesting session of the unit was learning about images. This session helped us know more on how an image is represented in computers and how to calculate the memory required to store an image as well as videos. The idea that the range of colours having different intensity values which is represented as numbers was a new learning for me from the unit. And further, the labs helped me more on understanding the concept better. Through labs we also learned how different filters such as rotations, reflections and translations work on images.

item.title: Unit 1 Reflection Blog
item.description:
UNIT 1 - REFLECTION

The Unit 1 felt quite easy compared to Unit 2. My understanding about data and information changed as we went through DIKW model. Earlier I thought data and information shares somewhat the same idea, but as we discussed in DIKW model, the raw data is getting processed to information. Further, the activities conducted in class such as the census of bangalore helped me study about the interpretation of data in real life.

item.title: My First Post
item.description:
REFLECTION BLOG

Hello Everyone,

Mahitha here! I am a student at Azim Premji University. I am doing my major in BSc Information Science. I am writing this blog to reflect on my classroom discussions and also share some of my learning experiences.

I am a person who loves to learn new things, but at sometimes, i feel nervous when it comes to learning technical subjects like information science. But my strong will for not giving up, helps me in understanding the subject step by step.
